page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r9i.3xlarge is a memory-optimized instance built on the KVM hypervisor and driven by the x86_64 architecture. The server is configured with 12 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at a base clock speed of 3.2 GHz. System memory totals 96.0 GB, establishing an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio suitable for workloads demanding elevated RAM capacity relative to processing cores.

Storage and networking are structured around decoupled resources. The ecs.r9i.3xlarge instance does not include bundled local storage, requiring external cloud block storage for operational filesystems and data persistence. Network connectivity provides a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses or GPU accelerators are included with the instance.

The 1:8 vCPU-to-memory proportion provides resource efficiency for memory-constrained environments where standard compute profiles exhaust available RAM prematurely. The server is suited for in-memory databases, memory-caching layers like Redis, big data analytics engines, and enterprise backend applications requiring dedicated compute and substantial memory density.
